title: A Separable Banach Space with a Schauder Basis Which Is Not a Lipschitz Retract of Its Bidual
summary: We construct a separable Banach space $X$ with a Schauder basis such that $B_X$ is not a uniformly continuous retract of $B_{X^{**}}$. Consequently, $X$ is not a uniformly continuous retract of $X^{**}$ and hence is not a Lipschitz retract of $X^{**}$.
